concept: A bright celebration garden that marks genuinely joyful moments with bold color, warm candlelight, and a welcoming party frame.
floor: One broad continuous warm-cream celebration floor across the full top face, made from a few oversized smooth stone slabs with no central dance-floor shape, confetti, or small pattern.
main_structure: One broad open celebration pavilion at the rear with a smooth wavy teal roof, two chunky cream pillars, and one small cake on a rear pedestal beneath it.
rear_props: two simple three-balloon bunches placed beside the pavilion
two large wrapped gift blocks with broad coral ribbons
side_props: one oversized coral flower form and one broad lantern on the upper-left edge
one oversized coral flower form and one broad lantern on the upper-right edge

perimeter.material: one continuous smooth teal celebration border made from broad rounded masses
perimeter.emblems: four oversized simple coral flower-petal emblems

lighting: clear cheerful daylight with two or three broad pools of warm candle and lantern glow
must_keep: copy the neutral reference island's exact canonical camera, canvas, hex footprint, straight front rim, centered stair entrance, tapered underside, and transparent padding
the bottom outline must be the same broad floating-island underside as the neutral reference, with a flat front hex edge interrupted only by the centered stairs
the stairs must read as an entrance cut into the front edge, not as a point or projecting nose
entire bottom/front half as quiet open celebration floor
all additions inside the original silhouette
must_exclude: creature or egg baked into the bitmap
center circle, raised or sunken platform, plaza, ring, distinct rug, path, or indentation
pointed front end, downward-pointing tip, triangular nose, projecting stair peninsula, altered hex silhouette, bridges, clouds, text, numbers, watermark, external shadow
confetti, garlands, bunting, fairy lights, tiny balloons, sprinkles, tiny flowers, grass blades, pebbles, cracks, specks, or dense clutter
